scope: Production React editor, test bridge, real Go app service and SQLite; no native Wails bridge or audio device
checks: External committed edits refresh the UI
Real mouse move commits to SQLite
Selection, copy, atomic deletion and undo
Gesture freezes revision and rejects conflicts
Arrow key submits one atomic selected-note batch
Composition/input events do not edit notes
Zoom does not change the project revision
Boundary resize atomically extends the clip
1k/10k spread-out notes mount at most 64 notes per page
Lost commit reply is resolved without replay
Unknown outcome retains a queryable operation ID
Delayed project reads and drag unmount cannot retarget edits
Remounted editor centers on its first note
React remount restores a single editor
